exposure: Fertility preservation procedures (cryopreservation of embryos, oocytes, ovarian tissue) when requiring Radical Hysterectomy (RH) or chemoradiotherapy
cohort: The study included 75 women under 45 years who underwent fertility-sparing treatment for invasive cervical cancer in a tertiary referral center in the Netherlands between January 2009 and January 2020.
finding: Many cervical cancer survivors maintain the desire for parenthood, and fertility-sparing treatments like VRT show good reproductive outcomes without compromising oncological safety, while fertility preservation and gestational surrogacy offer a promising alternative for those requiring gonadotoxic treatment.
